definitions.explanation: The act of making corrections or adjustments to fix errors or improve accuracy. Used in technical, budgetary, and everyday contexts.

examples.japanese: {補正|ほせい}⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{可決|かけつ}→可決：00148_kaketsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The supplementary budget was passed in the Diet.

examples.japanese: ⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{露出|ろしゅつ}→露出：08077_roshutsu⟧{補正|ほせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調整|ちょうせい}して→調整する：10442_chouseisuru⟧、⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{明|あか}るさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}えた→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: I adjusted the camera's exposure compensation to change the brightness of the photo.

notes:
{補正|ほせい} means to make corrections or adjustments that supplement or refine something — common across government, technology, photography, and statistics.

USAGE:
- Used as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb ({補正|ほせい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧) and as a noun in compounds.
- Emphasizes supplementing or fine-tuning something to improve it, rather than fixing an outright error.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {補正|ほせい}⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧: supplementary budget (an additional government budget passed after the initial annual one)
- ⟦{露出|ろしゅつ}→露出：08077_roshutsu⟧{補正|ほせい}: exposure compensation (photography)
- {補正|ほせい}⟦{下着|したぎ}→下着：01605_shitagi⟧: shapewear, body-shaping underwear
- ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{補正|ほせい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to apply corrections to data
- ⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦{調整|ちょうせい}→調整：14839_chousei⟧{補正|ほせい}: seasonal adjustment (statistics)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{修正|しゅうせい}→修正：03210_shuusei⟧: correction/amendment, implying that something was wrong and needs to be fixed.
- ⟦{訂正|ていせい}→訂正：16493_teisei⟧: correction of an error in a statement, document, or printed material.
- ⟦{調整|ちょうせい}→調整：14839_chousei⟧: adjustment, often without the connotation of error correction at all.
